title: Ferrari Roma in the Loft on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Midnight Garage: a liquid silver Ferrari Roma in the loft on a rainy night, rain running down the big window, coffee steaming on the bench and the city glowing below. 8 hours of smooth white noise, no music, for sleeping, studying, or blocking out the world while you work.

No music. No talking. No sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.

#parkedfm #whitenoise #sleepsounds #ferrariroma
